applicability: The projected body of any task document served by read_task_document_body, compared with the projection whose master join table is built from the whole canonical task-document set.
conditions: Graph-named masters and their explicitly listed valid child documents supply the addressed graph join; ordinary dependency projection reads the owning master and its explicit children.
Only payloads carrying the task-document schema enter the join; schema-less master-shaped JSON is not admitted merely through model defaults.
exclusions: Documents edited between two reads (a live mtime change is a real difference, not a projection difference).
Exact-path reads of historical notes/ or 0_archive copies, whose pre-existing served behaviour is preserved rather than asserted here.
statement: The bounded task-document body projection retains the corpus-projection equivalence boundary for leaf, master, standalone and sprint documents by using validated addressed TaskDocuments: graph-named masters and their explicitly listed children, plus the owning master and its listed task documents for ordinary dependency facts. It does not rely on a graph-master-only join.
